claims: American Idol 2026 voting is available via three methods.
One American Idol 2026 voting method is online at AmericanIdol.com/Vote.
One American Idol 2026 voting method is by texting the contestant's number to 21523.
One American Idol 2026 voting method is via official Instagram and TikTok pinned posts.
Up to 10 votes per contestant per method can be cast for American Idol 2026.
A total of 30+ votes can be cast per contestant for American Idol 2026.
American Idol 2026 voting usually starts at 7 PM CT.
The American Idol voting website is americanidol.com/vote.
American Idol voting requires creating an account on the website.
American Idol text voting uses the number 21523.
American Idol social media voting is by commenting the contestant's name on the pinned "Official Vote Post" on Instagram and Facebook.
American Idol 2026 voters must be located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
American Idol 2026 voting is generally open during live episodes.
